headline: Site plan and special permit for 179 apartments at 37 Enon Street, plus traffic and pedestrian safety reviews at Peabody, Larcom, Sargent, Hale, and Corning.
summary: The agenda covers a proposed 179-apartment building at 37 Enon Street. It also covers safety concerns at three intersections and a request to review parking on Essex and Cole Streets.
items: Public comment period, up to 15 minutes

Continued: recommendation to the Planning Board on Site Plan Review SPR 26-42 and Special Permit SP-26-5 for 37 Enon Street, submitted by Beverly Tre LLC c/o Alexander & Femino. Proposal: 179 residential apartments, about 2,600 square feet of retail space, and 281 parking spaces where 367 are required. Special permit needed to allow 1.5 parking spaces per residential unit.

Continued: constituent issue review of traffic and pedestrian safety concerns and possible recommendations at the intersection of Peabody Avenue, Larcom Avenue and Sargent Avenue, submitted by Scott Houseman, Ward 4 City Councilor
New: constituent issue review of pedestrian safety concerns and possible recommendation at the intersection of Hale Street and Corning Street, submitted by Scott Houseman, Ward 4 City Councilor

Recommendation to City Council: Order #258-2026, request for review along Essex Street and Cole Street, submitted by Matthew St. Hilaire, Councilor-at-Large. Continued over multiple meetings. This meeting will focus on prioritizing the eight areas requested for review, time permitting.

Construction or project updates, if any (standing item, may not be discussed): 119 Rantoul Street, Wendell Holmes LLC (owner), currently under construction, appears compliant with approved CMP, no update
location: Temporary Beverly City Hall, 1st Floor Conference Room, 175 Cabot Street, Beverly, MA
